title: sample-pair/1: how a samples/1 pairs with the files of a series
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample pair --json`: `samples` is the samples/1 in the order of the files, `pairing` every automatic choice made on the way (the same array the result of tp.dig_lr and tp.network carries as `pairing`). A sample whose file is not in the series is `left_out`; a file with no sample is `proposed` with the role its name gives and the part of the name that decided it. Nothing is refused for a choice; `status` is `adjusted` when there is one. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/samples/roles_pair.rs.

file.description: The file of the sample left out, or the file of the table that had no sample.

role.description: The role of the sample left out, or the role the name proposed.

evidence.description: proposed: the part of the name that decided the role, the minutes for a time zero, "" when no word did; left_out: "".
